lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.structures: Six NPC nodal CTVs: bilateral II+III+Va, IV+Vb and Ib
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.license: Code: GPL-3.0; dataset: CC BY 4.0; weights: licence not verified
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.limitations: NPC-specific institutional contouring conventions. Training data include contrast-enhanced and non-contrast CT. Grouped labels cannot be split into individual nodal levels. The paper also calls the lower-neck group IV+Vb+Vc; ROI names follow the release table. Development-cohort fixture checks do not establish independent accuracy.
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.description: LNCTVSeg nnU-Net v1: NPC-specific grouped elective nodal CTVs, not individual levels or visible-node masks.
